config.grain_rationale: One row is one current Victorian liquor licence (Licence Number) issued to a licensee at licensed premises. Business attributes of the holder (legal name, trading name) and the premises address are mapped; the licence number itself is the record key, not a business identifier.

record_id.rationale: Licence Number is present on every row and distinct across the discovery records (465 distinct / 465 records); it uniquely identifies a licence record.

fields.rationale: The 'Licensee' column names the holder of the liquor licence. Licences are issued to legal persons, so this is the holder's name as registered; values are mostly registered names ('ALDI FOODS PTY LIMITED', '... CLUB INC') but can be natural persons/sole traders (e.g. 'ARNOLD BRUCE'), so entity_type is left unknown rather than inferred.
Column is explicitly a trading name ('Trading As'), e.g. 'ALDI STORES' for licensee 'ALDI FOODS PTY LIMITED'. Placeholder punctuation such as '.' is treated as missing.

Street Address is the address of the licensed premises covered by the licence, not the licensee's registered office; mapped to generic address.full with explicit claim_scope licensed_premises. Placeholder '-' is treated as missing.

Suburb of the licensed premises, immediately following the street address. Uppercasing keeps the source's all-uppercase locality style and makes placeholder variants such as '[NOT APPLICABLE] -' detectable; those are treated as missing.
Postcode of the licensed premises block; the source's '0' placeholders are nulled before postcode normalisation.

constants.rationale: Register of Victorian liquor licences published by Liquor Control Victoria; the licensed premises are Victorian.

unmapped.reason: Identifier of the licence record, not a business identifier; also 8 digits and fails abn/acn checksums, so it must not feed those fields.
Category of the licence, not the legal entity's type or status; no allowed enum value fits licence categories.
Empty spacer column in the sheet.
Empty spacer column in the sheet.
Local government area of the premises; the ontology has no council field.
Administrative region label, no ontology target.
Location classification of the premises, no ontology target.

Postal/correspondence address of the licensee, which may be a PO box or interstate (Postal Suburb includes 'SYDNEY NSW'); not established as the registered office or the licensed premises, so it is left unmapped rather than conflated with the premises address.
Part of the licensee's postal/correspondence address; can be interstate (e.g. 'SYDNEY NSW'), so it cannot support the VIC premises-location constant and is left unmapped.
Part of the licensee's postal/correspondence address; can be interstate (e.g. 2000), so it cannot support the VIC premises-location constant and is left unmapped.

config.notes: Header row is row 5 of the sheet (contact/title rows above), hence skip_rows=4 with the named sheet. The sheet title says the list is current as of 31/08/2026; that is a snapshot date for the whole list, not a per-record observation, so observed_at falls back to resource_last_modified. No ABN/ACN column exists in this extract. Street Address/Suburb/Postcode are licensed-premises values and are emitted with claim_scope licensed_premises; the licensee's postal address is deliberately not mixed into those fields because it may be a PO box or interstate. Lat/Long, Council, Region and licence category are retained by the publisher but have no ontology target.
